description: Plain image-to-video LoRA that animates a still into a looping cinemagraph - one element moves (water, light), the rest stays frozen. Prompt for a locked-off camera, what stays frozen, what moves and a seamless loop. A 0.9 preview weight trained at 512x704, 25 frames on static-camera footage with no moving people; the card recommends STG scale 1.0 on block 29
use_when: Animate a still image into a looping cinemagraph
